coherence_stylistic.explantion: Response b is judged to have superior stylistic coherence. coverage_broad.explantion: Response b is judged superior because its critique report notes no major scope failures, while response a is flagged for Missing Major Aspect, Narrow Focus/Tunnel Vision, Lack of Context, and Superficial Listing. consistency_internal.explantion: Both responses exhibit fatal internal‑consistency flaws. In addition, each response asserts false consensus on contested legal issues. Because the severity and type of inconsistencies are comparable, neither response better distinguishes perspectives, leading to a tie.
